message.content: I wake up around nine, like I always do. My sister makes me some porridge for breakfast, and I eat it while watching the news. Then I get dressed, grab my bag, and take the bus to the shop. The bus ride is quiet, and I usually read a book or just sit and think. When I get to work, I start by pricing the notebooks and organizing the pens. I don’t have a lot of customers early in the morning, so it’s pretty calm. Sometimes I hear that voice, but it doesn’t bother me too much unless I haven’t slept well. I just try to focus on my tasks and keep the shop running smoothly.
